decisions.reason: A Danish date-field placeholder does not change or resolve the separate requirement governing the document's default language.
The source specifies placeholder content for the date field but does not change the separate uniqueness or non-repetition rules for persistent labels and help text.
Changing the date-field placeholder text does not alter when or how placeholder text must clear on activation.
The specified date-field text does not change the field implementation mechanism or architecture.
The date-field placeholder text is unrelated to bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source changes one field's user-facing placeholder and does not change style-catalog coverage or its source style system.
The date control's calendar-dropdown entry behavior remains unchanged; the placeholder wording is independently owned by the user-facing-text requirement.
Danish placeholder wording does not change the naming, prefix, or language of Word style names.
The source does not change the supported Word environment or any reliability and multi-user constraints.
The date-field placeholder has no effect on multi-digit numbered-list alignment.
The source specifies field text and does not change the required theme-color palette.
The date-field placeholder wording does not change legacy-content paste behavior, test files, or the unresolved formatting workflow.
